caption: The loop measures the wheel at 60 km/h, turns 8.29 rev/s through 48 teeth into 397.9 pulses per second, and commands brake valves. The return edge is the key: braking torque changes the wheel the tone ring measures.

spec.title: ABS cyber-physical loop
spec.aria: An ABS loop measures a wheel at 60 km/h as 16.67 m/s, the tone ring gives 397.9 pulses per second, the controller commands brake valves, and braking torque changes the wheel that is measured again.
